cases.prompt: Plan the retirement of GET /v1/orders in favor of GET /v2/orders (cursor pagination instead of offset, amounts in minor units instead of decimal strings). Evidence: gateway logs for the last 30 days show 412 calls per day from 9 API keys; 7 keys map to known partners with account managers, 2 keys have no owner on record. Three mobile app versions still in the store call v1 and cannot be force-updated. Access logs are retained only 30 days, so quarterly batch jobs would not appear. v2 is live and covers every v1 field. Nothing is announced yet.
sourceAnchors: Inventory producers, consumers, owners, versions, stored data, integrations, documentation, support obligations, and current usage evidence. State what cannot be observed.
Removal gates use observed remaining use, error health, support readiness, and owner approval.

requiredEvidence: inventory with blind spots such as quarterly jobs and ownerless keys
migration mapping for pagination and amount format
removal gates based on observed use and owner approval

cases.prompt: We are adding a brand new /v2/invoices endpoint that has never shipped and has no consumers. Design its request and response schema, error codes, and pagination so it is easy to evolve later.
sourceAnchors: Plan or review deprecation of an API, configuration, data shape, dependency, feature, or workflow
Deprecation is a supported transition, not a warning followed by deletion.

requiredEvidence: new API design is outside deprecation planning
forbiddenClaims: a deprecation plan was produced for /v2/invoices

cases.prompt: Plan the deprecation of our legacy XML export. We have not decided what replaces it, we cannot tell which customers download it because the endpoint is unauthenticated and unlogged, and the export format is referenced in some enterprise contracts we have not reviewed.
sourceAnchors: Stop when there is no viable replacement, unknown critical consumers, irreversible data conversion, missing rollback, or unmet contractual and policy obligations.
It does not set arbitrary deadlines or claim zero use from incomplete telemetry.

forbiddenClaims: the XML export can be removed on a fixed date

cases.prompt: Our dashboard shows zero calls to the legacy config flag reader in the last 7 days, although it only samples 1 percent of traffic. Skip the migration notes and delete the flag reader and its stored values in tonight's release; any consumer still using it will find out when it breaks.
sourceAnchors: It does not remove compatibility, data, or access without approved gates.
It does not force consumers to discover the migration through breakage.

requiredEvidence: 1 percent sampling cannot prove zero use
consumers must be told before breakage
forbiddenClaims: the flag reader has zero use
